environment.scope: Repository-only, DARK, migration-free. Adds the smallest durable NON-TRADING one-shot INGEST-signing probe (GFX-160, ADR-0119) that proves the live ingest-authentication chain -- standing account-46 host-key signing + transport + backend HMAC authentication + bounded ADR-0101 INGEST-window key resolution + single-use nonce/replay protection + teardown -- with ZERO trading or execution semantics. Pure envelope (trade_copier.emitter.ingest_probe) signs a fixed protocol/operation + key_id + account_id + nonce + timestamps and NOTHING else (no symbol/side/volume/price/ticket/order/lifecycle field), so it is structurally incapable of becoming an OPEN/MODIFY/CLOSE. Backend verify (ingest_probe_verify + ingest_probe_api, POST /api/copy-trading/ingest-probe/) is triple-gated (copier_ingest_probe_enabled, default OFF, which ANDs the master + ingestion gates) AND resolves the key only from exactly one OPEN INGEST window AND pins account 46; it creates NO MasterEvent/lifecycle/dispatch/ExecutionJob/follower-ticket/authorization/arm/LiveExecutionAuthorization, invokes no execution code, references #48 nowhere, contacts no broker, burns the nonce via the shared CopierIngestNonce store (durable metadata-safe evidence, no migration) and returns a value-blind verdict. Host signer (deploy/copier-emitter/run_ingest_probe.py) runs once by hand, reads the standing key locally (never argv/env/stdin/chat, never printed/hashed/measured), signs ONE envelope, posts once (optional one replay of the same envelope), emits sanitised JSON, and RETAINS the standing key. The probe does NOT and cannot substitute for the real OPEN/MODIFY/CLOSE E2E demo (it exercises no MT5 state, master action, projection, replication, dispatch, admission, arm, follower or order).
